briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ test runner.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declarations for the test runner facilities used within the µTest++ framework. It defines the runner class, which manages the registration and execution of test suites, including the static suites declared at namespace scope. The deprecated static_runner alias is declared in deprecated.h.

The test runner is responsible for initialising the test environment, creating the reporter, registering test suites, processing command-line arguments, and determining the overall test result via an exit code. It also provides a mechanism for aborting test execution.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
